exact_root_support.necessary_caution: Root addition gives potential Lie-bracket support; it does not determine source root-vector phases, coefficients or a physical field configuration.

independently_chosen_mathematical_model.model: Standard complexified D4=so8(C) in 8x8 matrices preserving J=[[0,I4],[I4,0]], with Cartan H_i=E_ii-E_(i+4,i+4) and integral Chevalley-type root matrices.
independently_chosen_mathematical_model.source_rank_one_minimal_example: Phi_c1=Phi_a1=1, all other Phi=0; two different x1,x2 1-form components give tr([Y1,Y2]^2)=8 in this complex 8x8 normalization.
independently_chosen_mathematical_model.zero_connection_derivatives_example: With spatial constant x1,x2 one-forms, x3=0, Phi constant, and w=B2=g=0, the formal Fw,FB2,Fx,Fg can be zero while Q=[X_p,X_q] is nonzero, in the specified complex model.
